task.description:
Implement the API-05 history endpoint per the design at src/design/api-05-history-endpoint.md.

Implementation tasks:
1. Add Store.readHistory() method to src/event_store/store.zig:
   - New method signature with HistoryReadOpts (event_type, from, to, after_sequence, limit)
   - UNION ALL query across events + events_archive tables
   - Ordered by sequence_number ASC
   - Filterable by event_type, from/to timestamps (inclusive)
   - Returns StoreError![]EventRecord with cursor pagination support
   - Instance existence check before query (return InstanceNotFound if instance_id not in instance_projections)
   - All SQL uses $1..$N placeholders (no string interpolation)

2. Add handleHistory handler to src/api/routes/instances.zig:
   - Parse HistoryParams from query string (event_type, from, to, cursor, page_size)
   - Parse instance_id from path param as UUID
   - Validate params: from > to → 422, invalid page_size → 422, unknown event_type → 422
   - Decode cursor: base64url, expect "H:" prefix, extract now_us + sequence_number
   - Cursor expiry: if now_us > 24h old → HTTP 410
   - Call Store.readHistory() with params
   - Build HistoryEvent[] from EventRecord[]
   - Encode next_cursor as base64url_no_pad("H:" || now_us || ":" || last_seq)
   - Return HistoryResponse JSON

3. Register route in main.zig or router:
   - GET /api/v1/instances/:id/history → handleHistory
   - Must be registered BEFORE the generic /:id route to avoid "history" being parsed as UUID
   - Any authenticated role (bootstrap token or real token)

Edge cases to handle:
- Instance not found → 404
- Instance exists but has no events → 200 with empty items[]
- from > to → 422
- Invalid cursor format → 422
- Expired cursor (>24h) → 410
- Unknown event_type → 422
- page_size ≤ 0 or > 200 → 422
- Pool exhausted → 503

Security rules (hard constraints):
- NO SQL string interpolation — use $1..$N placeholders via pg.zig
- NO secrets in source — credentials from environment variables
- NO catch unreachable on realistic failure paths — use typed error sets
- NO I/O in src/engine/transition.zig (not relevant here, but reminder)

Acceptance criteria:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
- All existing tests still pass (no regressions)
- New handleHistory compiles and is reachable via route
acceptance_criteria: Store.readHistory() implemented with UNION ALL across events + events_archive
handleHistory handler in instances.zig with full param parsing and validation
All cursor encoding/decoding works correctly (base64url, H: prefix)
All error cases return correct HTTP status codes (404, 410, 422, 500, 503)
No SQL string interpolation — all queries use $N placeholders
Existing tests pass with no regressions

All SQL uses  placeholders (no string interpolation). zig build and zig build test both exit 0.
